type_hypothesis.description: Retain CHARMM36 thymine types except for saturated product C5/C6 and H6, which use pinned CGenFF cyclobutane/dihydrouracil transfer candidates.
type_hypothesis.authority: candidate atom-type/Lennard-Jones hypothesis only; every ordered product requires independent QM and NAMD validation

charge_scope.variable_atoms: exact registry patch charge scope (28 product-base atoms)
charge_scope.fixed_atoms: all d(TpT) sugar, phosphate, and terminal-cap atoms at their effective CHARMM36 THY+DEOX+5TER/3TER values
charge_scope.reason: Ordered CPD stereoisomers need not be endpoint-exchange symmetric; only methyl hydrogens within one endpoint are symmetry-equivalent.

fit_hyperparameter_grid.esp_group_normalization: divide residuals by sqrt(points in the split)
fit_hyperparameter_grid.water_group_normalization: divide energy and distance residuals separately by sqrt(training sites)
fit_hyperparameter_grid.rationale: Finite preregistered grid spanning tight through permissive conventional charge regularization; fit choices are selected only with evidence not used by the optimizer. The charged d(TpT) dipole is compared at identical coordinates/origin and is not empirically scaled.

selection.esp_split: sort grid coordinates lexicographically, then hold out indices divisible by five
selection.water_split: train H3 donor and O2 acceptor sites from both endpoints; hold out both O4 acceptor sites
selection.failed_grid_behavior: retain the lowest-score diagnostic candidate but fail the release audit

acceptance.esp: report training and held-out RMSE plus improvement over native-THY initial charges; no universal release cutoff
acceptance.selection: select regularization and objective weights only by preregistered held-out metrics; never by visual appearance
